usage: pactkit context [-h] [--continuation] [--last-command LAST_COMMAND]
                       [--phase PHASE] [--blockers BLOCKERS] [--stdout]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --continuation        Update Agent Continuation section
  --last-command LAST_COMMAND
                        Last PDCA command run
  --phase PHASE         Phase reached
  --blockers BLOCKERS   Blockers or open questions
  --stdout              Print without writing cache
